subtopics.title: State and UT Categories in LEADS 2025
subtopics.summary: The LEADS 2025 edition sorts States and UTs into four categories: Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators and Growth-Seekers. Each entry carries a regional tag of Coastal, Landlocked, North-East (N-E) or UTs. Uttar Pradesh became an Exemplar after being an Achiever from 2022 to 2024, and Jammu and Kashmir moved from Fast Mover to High Performer.
facts: The 2025 edition introduced four new categories: Exemplars, High Performers, Accelerators and Growth-Seekers.
Exemplars (4): Tamil Nadu (Coastal), Uttar Pradesh (Landlocked), Mizoram (N-E) and Delhi (UTs).
Uttar Pradesh achieved Exemplar status after being categorised as an Achiever from 2022 to 2024.
High Performers (11): Gujarat (Coastal), Haryana (Landlocked), Tripura (N-E) and Jammu and Kashmir (UTs).
Jammu and Kashmir improved from Fast Mover in 2024 to High Performer in 2025.
Accelerators (17) include Andhra Pradesh (Coastal), Punjab (Landlocked) and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (UTs).
Growth-Seekers (4): West Bengal (Coastal), Rajasthan (Landlocked), Sikkim (N-E) and Andaman and Nicobar Islands (UTs).
The regional tags used in the report are Coastal, Landlocked, N-E (North-East) and UTs.

subtopics.title: National Logistics Initiatives and the World Bank LPI
subtopics.summary: Several national programmes aim to strengthen logistics, including the National Logistics Policy 2022, PM GatiShakti, Bharatmala Pariyojana, Sagarmala and the E-Way Bill System. India's logistics performance is also tracked globally through the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index. That index has six key dimensions and is reported by the World Bank every two years.
facts: The National Logistics Policy 2022 aims to lower the cost of logistics to par with other developed countries.
Logistics costs in India remain relatively high at around 7.97% of GDP.
The PM GatiShakti National Master Plan 2021 promotes integrated planning across roads, railways, ports, airports and logistics networks.
The Logistic Efficiency Enhancement Programme aims to enhance freight speed, reduce costs and improve tracking.
Bharatmala Pariyojana aims to improve road connectivity across India.
The Sagarmala Programme focuses on port-led development and boosts coastal shipping efficiency.
The E-Way Bill System mandates digital bills for goods, easing inter-state transport.
The Logistics Performance Index has six key dimensions, including customs performance, infrastructure quality and timeliness of shipments.
India ranked 38th among 139 countries in the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index 2023.
The World Bank reports the Logistics Performance Index every 2 years.
